title: Seven nurses can be arranged for one night
summary: Add a safe, explicitly night-only seventh-nurse role option.
changes: The night-only role editor now includes a Seventh nurse role whenever seven effective nurses are working, including named overtime staff.
The arrangement remains explicitly night-only, requires every effective nurse exactly once, and keeps the permanent rotation and automatic allocation rules unchanged.
A forward-only database upgrade validates seven-role assignments atomically before saving them.
